title: Death of Al-Muthanna
description: Al-Muthanna lived only a few months after his victory at Al-Buweib and died of wounds received at the battle of the Bridge, from which he never fully recovered. Jarir had refused to serve under him, a common Bedawi and not a Companion, and complained to 'Omar, who later appointed another commander over both. Dated to the year 0635 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "A. IT. 13-14."
